name: bikeshed-now
description: Versioned document publishing with highlight-anchored feedback, collaborative review, and an agent-facing publishing API.

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:functions
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix cli install
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:app
scripts.test:rules:emulated: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,database --project demo-bikeshed "npm run test:rules"
scripts.verify: npm run check:policy && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:brand && npm run check:headers
